space.name: Government-Wide Administration Space
space.description: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.

universe.description: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
includes: central personnel, budget, procurement, and digital administration

meta.description: Seven comparative representation systems for the space of government-wide administrative systems: submodel, structural-configuration, system-properties, function-allocation, decision-rights, and two WWBI indicator frames.

systems.name: submodel
systems.title: Submodel Characterisation Frame
systems.description: The note's own characterisation system: an orthogonal decomposition of a well-functioning government-wide administration into 23 submodels, each carrying the dimensions that locate a system within its domain.
systems.frame_basis: Functional submodel decomposition, optimised for comprehensive coverage and orthogonality.
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Full submodel characterization: every administrative submodel contributes characteristic elements to one profile.

groups.name: Coordination Model
groups.description: Organizational arrangement through which administrative action is coordinated across government.

groups.name: Functional Allocation Model

groups.name: Personnel Model

groups.name: Institutional Model
groups.description: Distribution and definition of administrative responsibilities among institutions.

groups.name: Authority Model
groups.description: Distribution of formal authority to make and enforce administrative decisions.

groups.name: Integration Model
groups.description: Extent to which administrative institutions, procedures, and information are connected across government.

groups.name: Standardization Model
groups.description: Extent to which common administrative rules, procedures, and standards apply across government.

groups.name: Administrative Control Model
groups.description: Mechanisms through which authorities influence and monitor administrative organizations.

groups.name: Service-Provision Model
groups.description: Organizational arrangements through which common administrative services are delivered.

groups.name: Regulatory Model
groups.description: How government-wide administrative rules and requirements are established and applied.

groups.name: Accountability Model
groups.description: Relationships through which administrative organizations account for decisions, compliance, and results.

groups.name: Digital Architecture Model

groups.name: Resource Allocation Model

groups.name: Capability Distribution Model

groups.name: Adaptation Model

groups.name: Performance Management Model
groups.description: Processes through which administrative performance is defined, measured, reviewed, and used.

groups.name: Governance and Steering Model

groups.name: Strategic Planning Model

groups.name: Administrative Process Model

groups.name: Administrative Knowledge and Learning Model

elements.name: Coordination structure
elements.description: Organizational arrangement through which administrative action is coordinated across government.

elements.name: Coordination authority
elements.description: Authority responsible for initiating, directing, and maintaining cross-government coordination.

elements.name: Coordination intensity
elements.description: Extent to which participating organizations coordinate their administrative activities.

elements.name: Conflict resolution
elements.description: Mechanisms used to resolve disagreements between administrative organizations.

elements.name: Participation requirements
elements.description: Extent to which administrative organizations are required to participate in coordination arrangements.

elements.name: Functional allocation
elements.description: Distribution of government-wide administrative functions among central authorities and participating organizations.

elements.name: Functional concentration
elements.description: Degree to which responsibility for a function is concentrated in a single organization or distributed across several organizations.

elements.name: Functional specialization
elements.description: Extent to which administrative organizations specialize in particular government-wide functions.

elements.name: Functional autonomy
elements.description: Degree of discretion organizations have over the execution of their assigned administrative functions.

elements.name: Functional overlap
elements.description: Extent to which administrative responsibilities overlap between institutions or organizations.

elements.name: Functional coverage
elements.description: Extent to which the administrative system assigns responsibility for the relevant government-wide functions.

elements.name: Career and employment system
elements.description: General arrangement through which public personnel enter, remain in, and progress through government employment.

elements.name: Recruitment system
elements.description: Principal arrangements for recruiting personnel into administrative positions.

elements.name: Selection authority
elements.description: Organizational level responsible for selecting personnel.

elements.name: Employment security
elements.description: Degree and basis of employment protection for public personnel.

elements.name: Career progression
elements.description: Principal mechanism through which personnel advance to higher positions or grades.

elements.name: Personnel mobility
elements.description: Extent to which personnel can move between government organizations and occupational groups.

elements.name: Remuneration system
elements.description: How salaries and related compensation are determined across government.

elements.name: Senior executive system
elements.description: Arrangements governing the recruitment, appointment, development, and management of senior administrators.

elements.name: Institutional configuration
elements.description: Distribution of government-wide administrative responsibilities among institutions and administrative bodies.

elements.name: Institutional mandate
elements.description: Degree to which the responsibilities and jurisdiction of each institution are formally defined.

elements.name: Institutional autonomy
elements.description: Degree of organizational independence enjoyed by administrative institutions.

elements.name: Institutional specialization
elements.description: Extent to which institutions have distinct functional mandates.

elements.name: Institutional hierarchy
elements.description: Formal hierarchical relationships among institutions responsible for government-wide administration.

elements.name: Institutional stability
elements.description: Degree of continuity in the system's institutional configuration.

elements.name: Decision-making authority
elements.description: Distribution of formal authority to make administrative decisions.

elements.name: Delegation arrangements
elements.description: Rules and practices governing the transfer of decision-making authority to subordinate or participating organizations.

elements.name: Reserved powers
elements.description: Decisions retained exclusively by central or designated authorities.

elements.name: Rulemaking authority
elements.description: Distribution of authority to establish administrative rules and binding standards.

elements.name: Enforcement authority
elements.description: Distribution of authority to enforce government-wide administrative requirements.

elements.name: Discretion
elements.description: Degree of freedom organizations have when applying common administrative requirements.

elements.name: Review and appeal rights
elements.description: Arrangements for reviewing administrative decisions and challenging their application.

elements.name: Institutional integration
elements.description: Extent to which administrative institutions operate through connected governance and organizational arrangements.

elements.name: Procedural integration
elements.description: Extent to which administrative procedures and workflows are coordinated across organizations.

elements.name: Information integration
elements.description: Extent to which administrative information is shared and usable across government organizations.

elements.name: Technical interoperability
elements.description: Ability of administrative information systems to exchange and process information.

elements.name: Semantic interoperability
elements.description: Extent to which organizations use compatible definitions, classifications, and meanings for shared information.

elements.name: Integration governance
elements.description: Arrangements for setting priorities, standards, and responsibilities for system-wide integration.

elements.name: Administrative standardization
elements.description: Extent to which common administrative rules, procedures, classifications, and standards apply across government.

elements.name: Standardization scope
elements.description: Range of organizations, functions, and processes covered by common standards.

elements.name: Standard-setting authority
elements.description: Authority responsible for establishing common administrative standards.

elements.name: Binding force
elements.description: Degree to which common standards are legally or administratively mandatory.

elements.name: Permitted variation
elements.description: Extent to which organizations may deviate from common administrative standards.

elements.name: Exception management
elements.description: Procedures for requesting, authorizing, documenting, and reviewing exceptions to common standards.

elements.name: Control mechanisms
elements.description: Principal mechanisms through which authorities influence and monitor administrative organizations.

elements.name: Ex ante control
elements.description: Extent to which decisions and transactions require approval or verification before execution.

elements.name: Ex post control
elements.description: Extent to which completed decisions and activities are reviewed for compliance and performance.

elements.name: Control locus
elements.description: Organizational level at which administrative control is primarily exercised.

elements.name: Corrective authority
elements.description: Authority to require corrective action when administrative deficiencies are identified.

elements.name: Sanctioning capacity
elements.description: Ability to impose consequences for noncompliance or administrative misconduct.

elements.name: Risk orientation
elements.description: Extent to which control activities are prioritized according to assessed risks.

elements.name: Shared-service provision
elements.description: Organizational arrangement through which common administrative services are delivered.

elements.name: Service ownership
elements.description: Institution responsible for defining service requirements and overseeing service delivery.

elements.name: Service delivery location
elements.description: Where common administrative services are operationally performed.

elements.name: Service coverage
elements.description: Range of organizations eligible or required to use shared administrative services.

elements.name: Service financing
elements.description: How shared administrative services are financed.

elements.name: Service-level governance
elements.description: How service quality, responsibilities, costs, and delivery expectations are agreed and monitored.

elements.name: Outsourcing arrangements
elements.description: Extent to which administrative service delivery is assigned to external providers.

elements.name: Rulemaking and regulation
elements.description: How government-wide administrative rules and requirements are established and applied.

elements.name: Regulatory scope
elements.description: Range of administrative functions and organizations governed by common regulatory arrangements.

elements.name: Regulatory hierarchy
elements.description: Relationship between general administrative rules and function-specific or organization-specific requirements.

elements.name: Regulatory coherence
elements.description: Degree to which administrative rules are mutually consistent and compatible.

elements.name: Regulatory discretion
elements.description: Degree of freedom available to authorities when interpreting and applying administrative rules.

elements.name: Rule revision
elements.description: Mechanisms for reviewing, updating, consolidating, and repealing administrative rules.

elements.name: Regulatory consultation
elements.description: Extent to which affected organizations and stakeholders participate in developing administrative rules.

elements.name: Accountability structure
elements.description: Arrangement of relationships through which administrative organizations account for decisions, compliance, and results.

elements.name: Accountability direction
elements.description: Direction in which administrative organizations and officials are required to account for their actions.
value_set: Downward to service users or the public

elements.name: Accountability scope
elements.description: Matters for which administrative actors are required to provide explanations or accept responsibility.

elements.name: Reporting obligations
elements.description: Requirements to submit administrative, financial, compliance, or performance information.

elements.name: Oversight independence
elements.description: Degree of independence enjoyed by bodies responsible for reviewing administrative conduct.

elements.name: Transparency obligations
elements.description: Requirements to disclose administrative information to oversight bodies and the public.

elements.name: Complaint and redress
elements.description: Mechanisms through which individuals and organizations can challenge administrative decisions or service failures.

elements.name: Remedial follow-through
elements.description: Extent to which findings from audits, investigations, and reviews result in corrective action.

elements.name: Digital infrastructure
elements.description: Organization of the digital infrastructure supporting administrative operations across government.

elements.name: Platform ownership
elements.description: Allocation of ownership and operational responsibility for shared digital platforms.

elements.name: Digital service architecture
elements.description: Arrangement of digital platforms, applications, interfaces, and services across government.

elements.name: Data stewardship
elements.description: Allocation of responsibility for data quality, definitions, access, maintenance, and reuse.

elements.name: Data-sharing authority
elements.description: Rules governing whether and how administrative data can be exchanged across organizations.

elements.name: Digital identity and access
elements.description: Arrangement for identifying users and managing access to administrative systems.

elements.name: Cybersecurity governance
elements.description: Allocation of responsibility for setting and enforcing government-wide cybersecurity requirements.

elements.name: Legacy-system dependence
elements.description: Degree to which administrative operations depend on outdated or difficult-to-integrate systems.

elements.name: Resource distribution
elements.description: How funding, personnel, and technical resources for government-wide administrative functions are allocated.

elements.name: Budgetary authority
elements.description: Distribution of authority to propose, approve, reallocate, and control administrative budgets.

elements.name: Funding predictability
elements.description: Degree to which administrative organizations can anticipate the resources available to them.

elements.name: Cost allocation
elements.description: Method used to assign the costs of shared administrative functions to participating organizations.

elements.name: Resource pooling
elements.description: Extent to which organizations combine or share resources to support common administrative functions.

elements.name: Procurement authority
elements.description: Distribution of authority for acquiring goods and services used in government-wide administration.

elements.name: Resource flexibility
elements.description: Degree to which organizations can reallocate resources in response to changing administrative needs.

elements.name: Administrative capacity distribution
elements.description: Distribution of administrative expertise and implementation capacity across government.

elements.name: Strategic capacity
elements.description: Distribution of expertise for system-wide planning, policy development, and administrative reform.

elements.name: Technical expertise
elements.description: Availability and distribution of specialized professional and technical knowledge.

elements.name: Leadership capacity
elements.description: Distribution of leadership and senior management capabilities across administrative organizations.

elements.name: Analytical capacity
elements.description: Ability to collect, interpret, and use evidence for administrative decisions and improvement.

elements.name: Capability development
elements.description: Arrangements for developing and maintaining administrative competencies.

elements.name: Capacity equalization
elements.description: Mechanisms for addressing differences in capability between organizations or levels of government.

elements.name: Implementation responsibility
elements.description: Allocation of responsibility for putting government-wide administrative policies and requirements into practice.

elements.name: Implementation discretion
elements.description: Degree of freedom organizations have to adapt common requirements during implementation.

elements.name: Implementation sequencing
elements.description: How implementation is scheduled across organizations and functions.

elements.name: Implementation support
elements.description: Assistance available to organizations implementing common administrative requirements.

elements.name: Compliance variation
elements.description: Degree to which organizations differ in their actual application of common requirements.

elements.name: Implementation monitoring
elements.description: Arrangements for tracking progress, identifying barriers, and verifying implementation.

elements.name: Implementation incentives
elements.description: Mechanisms used to encourage or secure implementation.

elements.name: Institutional adaptability
elements.description: Ability of the administrative system to respond to changing requirements and circumstances.

elements.name: Reform initiation
elements.description: Distribution of authority to identify and initiate administrative reforms.

elements.name: Reform coordination
elements.description: Arrangements for coordinating reform initiatives across government organizations.

elements.name: Change velocity
elements.description: Typical pace at which the system can approve and implement administrative changes.

elements.name: Experimentation
elements.description: Extent to which administrative organizations can test new approaches before wider adoption.

elements.name: Reform reversibility
elements.description: Ability to revise, discontinue, or reverse reforms when results are inadequate or circumstances change.

elements.name: Institutional memory
elements.description: Extent to which the system retains knowledge of previous reforms and organizational changes.

elements.name: Performance management arrangements
elements.description: Organization of the processes through which administrative performance is defined, measured, reviewed, and used.

elements.name: Indicator standardization
elements.description: Extent to which common definitions and indicators are used across administrative organizations.

elements.name: Target setting
elements.description: How administrative performance targets are established.

elements.name: Performance reporting
elements.description: Arrangements for reporting administrative results across government.

elements.name: Evaluation independence
elements.description: Degree to which performance assessments are independent of the organizations being assessed.

elements.name: Performance consequences
elements.description: Extent to which performance results influence administrative decisions and organizational behavior.

elements.name: Benchmarking
elements.description: Extent to which organizations compare administrative performance against common benchmarks or one another.

elements.name: Evaluation and learning cycle
elements.description: Extent to which performance evidence leads to review, corrective action, and subsequent reassessment.

elements.name: Strategic steering authority
elements.description: Authority responsible for setting the overall direction of government-wide administration.

elements.name: Leadership configuration
elements.description: Arrangement through which system-wide administrative leadership is exercised.

elements.name: Priority alignment
elements.description: Extent to which administrative organizations align their priorities with government-wide objectives.

elements.name: Cross-government decision forums
elements.description: Formal forums through which system-wide administrative decisions are discussed and made.

elements.name: Strategic dispute resolution
elements.description: Mechanisms for resolving competing priorities among administrative institutions.

elements.name: Steering accountability
elements.description: Arrangements for holding system-wide leaders and steering bodies accountable for their direction and decisions.

elements.name: Planning horizon
elements.description: Time period explicitly considered in government-wide administrative planning.

elements.name: Administrative strategy
elements.description: Extent to which government-wide administration is guided by an explicit strategic framework.

elements.name: Priority setting
elements.description: Process through which administrative development priorities are identified and ranked.

elements.name: Planning integration
elements.description: Degree to which administrative plans align with fiscal plans, workforce plans, digital strategies, and wider government objectives.

elements.name: Planning participation
elements.description: Extent to which administrative organizations and affected stakeholders contribute to strategic planning.

elements.name: Plan-to-budget linkage
elements.description: Degree to which administrative plans influence budget allocations and resource commitments.

elements.name: Strategic review
elements.description: Frequency and method by which administrative priorities and plans are reassessed.

elements.name: Process architecture
elements.description: How government-wide administrative workflows and procedures are structured.

elements.name: Process ownership
elements.description: Allocation of responsibility for the design, operation, and improvement of administrative processes.

elements.name: Workflow integration
elements.description: Degree to which processes connect activities across organizational boundaries.

elements.name: Process standardization
elements.description: Extent to which common process designs and procedures are used across organizations.

elements.name: Process automation
elements.description: Extent to which administrative processes are automated through digital systems.

elements.name: Process performance
elements.description: Extent to which process efficiency, timeliness, cost, and error rates are systematically measured.

elements.name: Process redesign
elements.description: Arrangements for simplifying, reengineering, and improving administrative workflows.

elements.name: Ethics framework
elements.description: Existence and scope of common ethical principles and conduct requirements for public administration.

elements.name: Conflict-of-interest management
elements.description: Arrangements for identifying, disclosing, preventing, and managing conflicts of interest.

elements.name: Anti-corruption coordination
elements.description: Organization of responsibilities for preventing and addressing corruption across government.

elements.name: Whistleblowing protection
elements.description: Legal and administrative protections and reporting channels for individuals who report misconduct.

elements.name: Integrity oversight
elements.description: Arrangements for monitoring compliance with ethics and integrity requirements.

elements.name: Disciplinary arrangements
elements.description: How misconduct is investigated, adjudicated, and sanctioned across government.

elements.name: Integrity risk management
elements.description: Extent to which corruption and ethical risks are systematically identified and mitigated.

elements.name: Territorial coverage
elements.description: Levels of government included in the administrative system's jurisdiction or coordination arrangements.

elements.name: Subnational administrative autonomy
elements.description: Degree of discretion exercised by subnational authorities over administrative arrangements.

elements.name: Intergovernmental coordination
elements.description: Arrangements for coordinating administrative policies and practices across territorial levels.

elements.name: Administrative standards reach
elements.description: Extent to which government-wide administrative standards apply across territorial levels.

elements.name: Fiscal-administrative linkage
elements.description: Relationship between resource transfers and administrative responsibilities across levels of government.

elements.name: Capacity equalization
elements.description: Arrangements for addressing differences in administrative capability across territorial governments.

elements.name: Intergovernmental dispute resolution
elements.description: Mechanisms for resolving administrative disputes between territorial levels of government.

elements.name: Knowledge management
elements.description: Arrangements for documenting, organizing, and making administrative knowledge available across government.

elements.name: Institutional memory
elements.description: Extent to which administrative records, precedents, decisions, and lessons survive personnel turnover and institutional change.

elements.name: Knowledge sharing
elements.description: Extent to which administrative organizations exchange expertise, lessons, and effective practices.

elements.name: Lessons-learned processes
elements.description: Mechanisms for identifying and applying lessons from implementation, audits, evaluations, and administrative failures.

elements.name: Professional learning networks
elements.description: Arrangements for connecting administrative professionals across organizations to exchange knowledge and expertise.

elements.name: Evidence use
elements.description: Extent to which research, administrative data, evaluations, and operational evidence inform administrative decisions.

elements.name: Knowledge transfer
elements.description: Arrangements for transferring expertise and administrative knowledge between organizations, roles, and generations of personnel.

systems.name: structural-configuration
systems.title: Structural Configuration Frame
systems.description: Locates a government-wide administrative system by the shape of its organization: how differentiated, how layered, how formalized, and how autonomous its units are.
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Compare structural configuration: how the administration is shaped.

groups.name: Structural dimensions
groups.description: Configuration of the administrative structure.

elements.name: Functional specialization
elements.description: Degree to which administrative units are differentiated by specialized function.

elements.name: Vertical differentiation
elements.description: Number of hierarchical levels separating top authority from operating units.

elements.name: Horizontal differentiation
elements.description: Number of distinct organizational units or functions coexisting at the same level.

elements.name: Span of control
elements.description: Number of subordinates reporting to a typical supervisor.

elements.name: Formalization
elements.description: Extent to which rules, procedures, and roles are written and prescribed.

elements.name: Procedural standardization
elements.description: Extent to which like activities follow common prescribed procedures.

elements.name: Centralization of authority
elements.description: Locus of decision-making authority in the hierarchy.

elements.name: Configuration
elements.description: Overall shape of the structure.

elements.name: Line-staff balance
elements.description: Relative weight of line authority versus staff and advisory units.

elements.name: Administrative intensity
elements.description: Proportion of administrative and managerial staff relative to operating staff.

elements.name: Professionalization
elements.description: Extent to which staff hold formal professional qualifications.

elements.name: Unit autonomy
elements.description: Organizational independence of constituent units.

systems.name: system-properties
systems.title: System-Property Frame
systems.description: Locates a government-wide administrative system by graded system-wide qualities, as spectra rather than types.
systems.frame_basis: Extension of the note's properties table (centralization, standardization, integration, sharing, interoperability) into a full property space.
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Compare system-wide properties: centralization, formalization, and coherence.

groups.name: Property spectra
groups.description: Graded qualities of the whole system.

elements.name: Centralization
elements.description: Concentration of authority and coordination in centers versus agencies.

elements.name: Standardization
elements.description: Extent of common procedures, rules, and requirements.

elements.name: Integration
elements.description: Cross-boundary linkage of functions and processes.

elements.name: Sharing
elements.description: Central or joint versus replicated service provision.

elements.name: Interoperability
elements.description: Cross-boundary capacity of systems and data.

elements.name: Autonomy
elements.description: Discretion of component organizations.

elements.name: Discretion
elements.description: Freedom in applying common administrative requirements.

elements.name: Formalization
elements.description: Degree to which arrangements are legally or administratively prescribed.

elements.name: Coordination intensity
elements.description: Frequency and intensity of cross-organization coordination.

elements.name: Transparency
elements.description: Public accessibility of decisions, information, and operations.

elements.name: Predictability
elements.description: Stability and anticipability of rules and resourcing.

elements.name: Adaptability
elements.description: Capacity of the system to change its arrangements.

systems.name: function-allocation
systems.title: Function-Allocation Frame
systems.description: Locates a government-wide administrative system by where each core administrative function is performed along the center-agency axis.
systems.frame_basis: Distribution of the core administrative functions across performers.
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Compare how administrative functions are allocated across units.

groups.name: Function areas
groups.description: Allocation of core administrative functions.

elements.name: Budgeting function
elements.description: Where budget formulation, allocation, and control are performed.

elements.name: Accounting function
elements.description: Where accounting and financial reporting are performed.

elements.name: Human resource function
elements.description: Where public-employment and workforce management are performed.

elements.name: Procurement function
elements.description: Where public procurement and asset management are performed.

elements.name: Records and information function
elements.description: Where records management and information exchange are performed.

elements.name: Digital and information function
elements.description: Where common information systems and digital platforms are operated.

elements.name: Legal and regulatory function
elements.description: Where administrative-rule drafting and interpretation are performed.

elements.name: Audit and inspection function
elements.description: Where auditing, inspecting, and review are performed.

elements.name: Performance-evaluation function
elements.description: Where administrative performance is defined, measured, and used.

systems.purpose: Compare where administrative decision rights sit.

groups.name: Decision domains
groups.description: Locus of authority per decision domain.

elements.name: Agenda-setting authority

systems.name: wwbi-employment-profile
systems.title: Public Employment Profile (WWBI)
systems.description: Locates a government-wide administrative system by the demographics of its public workforce, using the indicator families of the World Bank Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators.
systems.frame_basis: World Bank Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators (WWBI) - public employment demographics (commercial indicator framework: public sector footprint and workforce composition).
systems.provenance: World Bank Worldwide Bureaucracy Indicators (WWBI), 302 indicators, 202 economies
systems.universe: Government-wide administrative systems: the cross-government coordinating arrangements of a polity over its ministries, agencies, and territorial administrations.
systems.purpose: Compare public-employment profiles using World Bank WWBI indicators.

groups.description: Composition of the public-sector workforce.

elements.name: Female representation

elements.name: Age structure

elements.name: Occupational composition

elements.name: Income-quintile composition

systems.name: wwbi-compensation-profile
